Manheim Used Vehicle Value Index: August 2026 Trends
Sep. 8, 2026 5 min Read
Key Metrics
  • The Manheim Used Vehicle Value Index (MUVVI) in August was 208.2, reflecting a 0.4% increase for wholesale used-vehicle prices (adjusted for mix, mileage, and seasonality) compared to August 2025. The index is down 0.9% month over month. The long-term average monthly move for August is an increase of 0.5%.
  • Non-adjusted wholesale vehicle prices are now up 0.2% year over year, and down 0.5% against July 2026. The long-term average monthly move in non-adjusted values for August is an increase of 0.1%.
